messages:
maya: Customer (james) escalated — streaming SSE stops mid-response after ~20-30s. Partial output seen, client reconnects and gets duplicate content (billing double-count). Hits behind Cloudflare -> ALB -> nginx -> origin. Repro steps + logs below.

customer-james: repro steps:
1) curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \\
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","prompt":"very long prompt..."}' https://api.example.com/v1/stream
It streams for ~25s then connection drops. Client reconnects automatically and we see another full response and separate billing entry.

maya: Customer pasted these upstream responses: Cloudflare returns `524 A timeout occurred` and ALB target group reports `502` on the connection close. Trace id: tr-zz123.

dmitri: Can you dump request/response headers and the CF-Connecting-IP / trace headers? Also confirm ALB idle-timeout. This looks like an idle timeout mismatch or proxy coalescing causing silence.

customer-james: Headers excerpt:
```
:method: POST
:authority: api.example.com
user-agent: curl/7.68.0
accept: text/event-stream
authorization: Bearer REDACTED
content-type: application/json
transfer-encoding: chunked
```
No unusual headers. ALB idle timeout reported by ops team is 60s. Cloudflare default ~100s.

carla: With SSE small chunks and intermittent silence, nginx/edge proxies often buffer until buffer full or connection close unless `proxy_buffering off`. Also if Cloudflare/ALB have different keepalive/idle values you can get FIN midstream. Does app emit heartbeats?

maya: App is supposed to send SSE comment heartbeat every 15s. Customer's chunk timeline shows:
```
0.0s: event: message data: "Hello"


15.2s: event: message data: " world"


30.6s: connection reset by peer
```
So heartbeat at 15s arrives but nothing between 15s and 30s. We expected either small token chunks or a comment at 30s but nothing showed.

dmitri: Possible causes: Cloudflare coalescing/suppressing empty TCP frames; nginx proxy_buffering reassembling small writes; ALB half-close when it sees inactivity from its TCP perspective. Also TLS termination points matter (CF -> ALB -> origin). If Cloudflare sends FIN due to perceived idle, ALB might drop origin connection.

carla: Quick mitigation suggestions:
- On nginx: set `proxy_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; chunked_transfer_encoding on; proxy_set_header Connection "";` for the SSE location.
- Ensure server sets `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and doesn't use `Content-Length`.
- Emit a non-empty SSE comment or small padding every 10s (e.g., `:hb\n\n` or `data: "\\u200b"\n\n`) to avoid proxy aggregation.
- Increase ALB idle timeout to >= 120s to match Cloudflare or adjust Cloudflare origin_keepalive settings.

maya: Customer is on managed Cloudflare and reluctant to change edge settings. They tried app changes but still saw resets. Any server-side hardening?

dmitri: Server-side we can do two things: 1) increase chunk frequency / send padding as suggested; 2) implement short-lived idempotency for streaming sessions using `X-Request-Id` so that reconnects within a window are deduped in billing. Billing change needs product/finance sign-off but we can do a temporary mitigation: if same `X-Request-Id` seen within 60s mark subsequent streams as "reconnect" and don't count until stream completes without reset.

customer-james: For debugging I can provide tcpdump from origin to ALB and CF edge logs. Would that help?

carla: Yes — we need 3 traces: client->Cloudflare, Cloudflare->ALB, ALB->nginx/origin. Look for TCP FIN/RST around the drop and note if Cloudflare sent a `524` first. Also check nginx `proxy_buffering`/`proxy_busy_buffers_size` metrics.

mike-qa: Note: some CF features (response buffering / acceleration / workers) can buffer responses at edge and drop if upstream silent. In many cases disabling response buffering or enabling `origin_keepalive_timeout` helps. Also check if any Cloudflare WAF rules triggered on long-running responses.

devops-bot: Ticket SR-9845 created: https://redwood-inc.atlassian.net/browse/SR-9845. Assigned: dmitri. Priority: P1 (customer paid).

dmitri: I'll spin up a repro harness that mirrors CF->ALB->nginx->app with adjustable idle timers and zero-byte periods. If I can reproduce reliably I'll propose: send periodic SSE comments every 10s by default in our SDK, add guidance to docs, and start a small billing dedupe RFC.

maya: For immediate customer steps to try:
- Set nginx `proxy_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; chunked_transfer_encoding on;`
- Emit SSE comment heartbeat every 8-10s (non-empty) from app
- Increase ALB idle timeout to >= 120s
- If possible, adjust Cloudflare origin keepalive/response buffering off for that route

customer-james: I'll try nginx + heartbeat + ALB change and report back with packet captures if still failing. Thanks for the quick triage.

maya: Thanks all — keeping this P1. Will follow up in ticket. :pray:
